machineRecipes.description: Install the Docker Sandboxes CLI on this computer.

steps.body:
set -eu
. /etc/os-release
[ "$ID" = ubuntu ]
dpkg --compare-versions "$VERSION_ID" ge 24.04
installer=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f -- "$installer"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o "$installer"
REPO_ONLY=1 sh "$installer"

check.body:
set -eu
. /etc/os-release
[ "$ID" = ubuntu ] || exit 2
dpkg --compare-versions "$VERSION_ID" ge 24.04 || exit 2
apt-cache show docker-sbx >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1
